cuts.label: Take 1
cuts.notes: Man in blue pyjamas claps the lamp off, the shaggy dog brings it back on, several toggles, then the pillow over his face; a second lamp on the right never goes off, so the off moments are only half-dark, and the jingle is Clap-Lite! Lights that listen! rather than the real Clapper line.

cuts.label: Take 2 (commercial structure)
cuts.notes: Transcript: Tired of stumbling in the dark? (2.0 s) / Introducing Clap-Lite. (4.7) / Clap-Lite. Lights that listen. Order yours today. (11.8). Grandma stubs her toe in the dark, claps the one lamp on, then quick demos (dad claps the TV on, a boy claps his lamp on) and a glowing-dome packshot with our CLAP-LITE, ONLY $19.95 and blinking CALL NOW 555-0147; an unlit second lamp shape is faintly visible in the dark opening shot (only one ever lights).
